overview.description: The TDAQ Lift ETF (TDAX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF designed to deliver 130% of the daily performance of TDAQ through the use of swaps and, at times, call options. The fund resets its exposure daily and does not seek to achieve its objective over periods longer than one trading day TDAX was launched on Jan 7, 2026 and is issued by TappAlpha.
